proposal.description: A 'fast release' path: the non-safe (released) level goes from async_in straight to sync_out, and only a return to the safe RESET_VALUE goes through meta_ff
proposal.reason: With RESET_VALUE=0, a rising async_in shows on sync_out one clock early (after one flop, not two), and a one-clock high glitch shows on sync_out while still asserted at the clock edge, where a correct synchroniser delays it two clocks.

proposal.description: The first stage waits for the second stage to catch up (handshake) before taking a new sample of async_in, instead of sampling every clock
proposal.reason: A one-clock pulse on async_in is stretched to two clocks on sync_out, and a change that comes right after another is seen one clock late, because meta_ff holds for a clock after every change.

proposal.description: 'Assume the worst' is applied every clock: whenever meta_ff and async_in disagree, sync_out is forced to the safe RESET_VALUE instead of taking meta_ff
proposal.reason: With RESET_VALUE=0, a falling async_in shows on sync_out one clock early, and a one-clock high pulse on async_in never reaches sync_out, where a correct synchroniser passes it through two clocks later.
